author: Cleo Abram
description:
Why do we find SO MANY meteorites in Antarctica? 60% of meteorites found on Earth are found there! It’s not because it’s at the pole.

The reason is these special blue ice areas. And how they form…

title: Why Antarctica Has SO MANY Meteorites
